Join Evoke’s Data Engineering Team
At Evoke, data is at the heart of how we build, innovate, and make decisions. Our Data Technologies Group plays a central role across the organization, making data accessible, reliable, and actionable for stakeholders across the business.
We’re currently undergoing an exciting technology transformation—moving from legacy on-premise systems to a modern, cloud-native data platform powered by technologies such as AWS, Snowflake, Airflow, and dbt.
As a Data Engineer on our Cross Development Team, you’ll be part of this transformation, designing and developing robust backend data solutions that integrate a wide range of data sources. You’ll own solutions from development through production, with a strong focus on data quality, scalability, reliability, and performance .
This is an opportunity to work at the core of Evoke’s data ecosystem, tackle meaningful engineering challenges, and help shape the future of our data platform.
Be part of Data engineers team working in Agile methodology.
Develop complex Data Pipelines using Microsoft ETL technologies (SSIS).
Develop new Data Processes using Apache Airflow, DBT & Snowflake.
Working with high scale databases and providing Back-End Data solution from design phase, through development and up to implementation.
Working with various stakeholders and applications across the company.
 What You'll Be Doing
 As a Data Engineer you will be responsible for:
Designing and developing complex ETL processes and data driven solutions.
Working with high scale databases and providing Backend BI solution from design phase, through development and up to implementation.
Working with various stakeholders and applications across the company.
 Job Requirements
 Who We're Looking For
At least 3 years of experience with large-scale DWH environments.
At least 3 years of experience in design and development of ETL processes in SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
Strong background in writing SQL queries and procedures.
High English language skills.
 Advantage If You Have
Experience in DBT / Apache Airflow.
Experience in Snowflake.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science / IS Engineering / Related field.
Experience working in Agile methodology.
Highly motivated and independent.
